mapper.select: SELECT count FROM rate_limit_bucket WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND bucket_key = #{bucketKey} AND window_start = to_timestamp( floor(extract(epoch from now()) / #{windowSeconds})::bigint * #{windowSeconds})

WITH cur AS ( INSERT INTO rate_limit_bucket (tenant_id, bucket_key, window_start, count, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{bucketKey}, to_timestamp(floor(extract(epoch from now()) / #{windowSeconds})::bigint * #{windowSeconds}), 1, now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, bucket_key, window_start) DO UPDATE SET count = rate_limit_bucket.count + 1, updated_at = now() RETURNING count ) SELECT count FROM cur
